Done. The tree is clean and the single commit is on the branch.

## 1. Changed

- `frontend/src/App.tsx` — added `<Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />` as the last child of the `<Shell />` route group.
- `frontend/src/pages/NotFound.tsx` — new page: `ViewHead` (kicker + heading), `Panel` with one-sentence body, the requested `useLocation().pathname` in a `.mono` span, and a primary `Btn` wrapped in `Link to="/"`. Only i18n keys; `data-testid`s for `notfound-body`, `notfound-path`, `notfound-home`.
- `frontend/src/layout/nav.ts` — new `ROUTE_PATHS` list (mirrors the route table) with a comment saying it must be kept in step with `App.tsx`.
- `frontend/src/layout/Shell.tsx` — `crumbKeyFor` returns `nav.notFound` when no `ROUTE_PATHS` pattern matches via `matchPath`, so a stale sub-route like `/registry/old-record-view` no longer labels itself "REGISTRY".
- `frontend/src/locales/en/common.json`, `frontend/src/locales/zh-CN/common.json` — `nav.notFound` plus a `notFound.*` block (kicker, title, panelTitle, panelSub, body, pathLabel, backToOverview) in both locales.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — new "Console routing" / "控制台路由" section before the authentication section describing the route table, `?view=` convention, catch-all inside the Shell, and the `ROUTE_PATHS` crumb rule.

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ `App.tsx` has `<Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />` inside the `<Shell />` group (`frontend/src/App.tsx:42`).
- ✅ `frontend/src/pages/NotFound.tsx` uses `ViewHead` + `Panel` + `Btn` inside `Link to="/"`, shows `useLocation().pathname` in a `.mono` span, all strings via `t()`; new keys in both locales, `i18n_check.py` passes.
- ✅ Screenshots: `curl -s localhost:5173/ | grep -o '<title>[^<]*'` printed `<title>AgentCore Launchpad`; Playwright captures saved to `.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-001/notfound_en.png` and `notfound_zh.png` (1440×900), showing sidebar, topbar, footer and the not-found panel. Note: the capture targeted my worktree's throwaway vite on :5197 (proxying to the host's :8000), since :5173 serves the host checkout without this change. The host should re-capture from :5173 after merging.
- ✅ Breadcrumb reads "CONSOLE / NOT FOUND" (en) and "CONSOLE / 页面不存在" (zh-CN), asserted in the script and visible in the screenshots.
- ✅ `make verify` passes. No live AWS call was made.
- ✅ `make verify` passes in this worktree.
- ⚠️ Hermetic test: the frontend has no unit-test runner, so the gate coverage for this change is eslint + tsc + vite build plus i18n parity. The behavioural check (crumb, path, shell chrome, back link, stale sub-route case) lives in the Playwright script I ran, which is not part of the gate. No backend test applies since no backend code changed.
- ✅ `docs/architecture.md` and its `.zh-CN` twin updated. `docs/api.md` untouched because no API route changed.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Crumb resolution uses a mirrored path list.** `crumbKeyFor` runs in the Shell, above the `<Outlet />`, so it cannot see which route matched. I added `ROUTE_PATHS` in `layout/nav.ts` and check it with `matchPath`. It duplicates the route table and must be updated alongside `App.tsx`. I documented that rule in the architecture docs and the code comment. The alternative, moving to a data router or route-object config, would have been a wider refactor than this direction warrants.
- **Side effect of the crumb change:** previously an unrouted path under a module prefix showed that module's crumb. It now shows "NOT FOUND", which matches the requirement.
- **Screenshot source:** captured from the worktree's own vite on :5197, not the host's :5173, as the brief's guidance allowed. The :5197 instance was stopped afterwards.
- The pre-existing lint warning in `EvaluationExperiment.tsx` is out of scope and left alone.
- Screenshots are in the gitignored runs directory and were not committed.
